task_description: Classify a single code snippet into one high-level CWE category from a fixed list, explaining briefly.

dataset_alignment.tie_breaking_policy: Prefer 'Others' over speculative mapping; 'Correct' only when explicit absence of vulnerability is established.

evidence_priority: Coding standard violations without concrete fault
rubric.reason_style: Brief, specific to the snippet; avoid generic CWE definitions.

confusion_pairs.disambiguation: If mishandled error states, cleanup, or propagation -> CWE-703; if only style/standards issues without fault -> CWE-710.
Mechanism present but failing (e.g., crypto or auth checks broken) -> CWE-693; missing/incorrect enforcement of access rules -> CWE-284.

failure_modes: Selecting multiple categories or deviating from required format
Over-indexing on comments rather than code behavior
Ignoring mask/cleanup/NULL checks leading to resource leaks

metrics.notes: High confusion CWE-703 vs CWE-710; add sharper rules.

positive.pattern: Early return on error without freeing allocated buffer
